Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1234
Claimant:
Jennifer Johnson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2 Feb 2025
The claimant reported a low-speed head-on collision and a neck strain, and the file was opened for review. The
claimant is not represented by an attorney, so all contact has been made directly with the claimant.
10 Mar 2025
The driver named on the policy was confirmed as the operator of the insured vehicle at the time of the incident. Police
records and witness statements place the claimant inside the vehicle when it was struck.
21 Mar 2025
Photographs supplied by the claimant show damage that corresponds to the decsribed impact. No independent
witnesses have come forward, so the photos are the main source of visual detail for this loss.
29 May 2025
Records show no prior damage to the vehicle and nothing suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. The
reported injury pattern also fits the kind and force of a crash at this speed.
26 Jun 2025
The claimant gave the same account of the collision in each conversation, with no changes in sequence or detail. No
earlier injury to the neck or upper back has come to light in the medical history review.
22 Jul 2025
Treatment follwoed a usual course, with care tapering off as the claimant improved. The treating records are
consistent with the reported symptoms and recovery timeline.
29 Aug 2025
Based on the information reviewed to date, the claim is ready for a settlement evaluation. The file will be closed once
the final medical bill and repair invoice are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
